observations: The target caller loads AH from directory entry byte zero and AL from its attribute byte, calls the recovered capture routine, and branches on its result.
After that call the target retains the historical Search logic checking end-of-directory, deleted marker and volume attribute.
A later target window matches the historical dir.obj Search code, supporting the association with dos/dir.asm.
limitations: The target may organize routines across files differently from the historical reference.
Only this local caller and short historical anchors are verified; the entire Search function has not been reconstructed.
The capture procedure ownership remains unknown even though the Search caller is identified.
